requirements.title: Bind each operation to its effects
Join screens, APIs, and durable state
Enforce numeric limits at their actual boundary
Use one error vocabulary and validation order
Keep progress, assessment, and test exposure independent
Preserve complete import and reuse meaning
Ship concrete teaching inputs and verifier profiles

cases.name: Bind each operation to its effects
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: Enumerate operation labels and the weights/registry effects matrix.
Inject a generation result labelled as training and a queued job labelled executed.
expected: Unknown or misleading effects fail validation/render assertions; operation labels remain distinct.

cases.name: Join screens, APIs, and durable state
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: Execute each local screen action through the exact documented API using an isolated root.
Verify every committed object ID resolves and every failed revision check leaves state unchanged.
expected: No dangling UI action, fabricated success, unknown schema field or missing persisted result.

cases.name: Define the TinyLM v2 mechanics
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: Run fixed-seed standard tiny-v2 and protected pure-mechanics parity controls.
Verify P=137088 at V257/C64/W64/L2 and the tied delta 16448; train the 257-byte tokenizer and BPE 320 on the same ordered fixture.

Run legacy TinyLM and tiny-v2 at torch.set_num_threads(1) and set_num_interop_threads(1) with seed 17, V257/C64/W64/H4/L2; compare initial logits/loss; train byte-bpe-v1 with vocab_size 257; submit tiny_train whose train split has 200,001 text bytes and whose validation split has 150,000.
expected: Architecture and optimizer match the bound source; tokenization is deterministic; the byte run has zero merges; the actual BPE vocab is reported; no implicit weights update occurs.

Initial logits and loss agree within absolute and relative 1e-6; tokenizer IDs, shifted targets, parameter count and greedy IDs are exactly equal; byte-bpe-v1 at 257 yields tokenizer_type byte with zero merges; the 200,001-byte train split returns 400 VALIDATION_FAILED reason PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE while validation bytes are not counted.

cases.name: Serialize TinyLM checkpoints without pickle
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: Compare an uninterrupted 50-update run to 25 updates plus resume 25 updates, using the same profile and fixed seed.
Inject bad tensor name, mismatched lock/dataset, missing optimizer and alias cycle.
Run 100 updates with eval_every 25; list checkpoints; read manifest.json and recompute each descriptor sha256; export inference-only and compare digests.
expected: Tensors, RNG, fixed metrics and greedy tokens are equal, with identity/time fields excluded; an invalid checkpoint is rejected before load; an inference-only checkpoint cannot resume.

Checkpoints exist at steps 0, 25, 50, 75, 100 with save_every 25; descriptor sha256 equals SHA-256 of manifest.json bytes; manifests validate against checkpoint-manifest.schema.json and trainer_state.json against tiny-trainer-state.schema.json; the inference-only copy has a different manifest and digest and portability inference_only.

cases.name: Define complete byte-normalized evaluation
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: Calculate record A (6 nats/3 bytes) and record B (4 nats/8 bytes) aggregate; evaluate the uniform V257 model on the one-byte + EOS fixture.
Evaluate all records with two tokenizations over identical original bytes and verify no first/last target omitted.
expected: Aggregate is 10/11 within 1e-12, not 1.25; the uniform NLL is 2 ln 257; token_count includes EOS, and the denominator is only original UTF-8 bytes; no skipped records.

cases.name: Freeze preview and decoding semantics
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: Create tiny and applied context previews, then generate using exactly matching requests.
Alter one prompt byte, the seed, the token budget, the subject or the template after the preview; test EOS, ties at top-p, nucleus cropping and cancellation.

Replay every selection_cases and stop_cases row of fixtures/applied/decode-oracle-v1.json through the tiny and chat decode-step functions with injected logits; preview a tiny prompt whose byte-token window starts inside a multi-byte character; submit the preview's generation with top_p written as 1.0 instead of 1.
expected: The matching preview is used; a changed request rejects with CONTEXT_PREVIEW_STALE before inference; output IDs, count, stop reason and input cropping agree with the oracle.

Sorted order, retained sets, greedy choices, stop reasons, counts and visible IDs equal the oracle; the cropped window's serialized_text begins with U+FFFD and cropped_input_tokens equals original minus final; numerically equal spellings produce the same canonical digest and the generation is accepted.

cases.name: Enforce numeric limits at their actual boundary
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: For every INT-007 numeric boundary submit at the limit and at limit + 1; repeat every text limit with 1-, 2-, 3- and 4-byte scalars (U+0041, U+00E9, U+20AC, U+1F600).
Queue jobs until committed plus reserved bytes are within 1 MiB of 50 GiB, then force ENOSPC after acceptance.
Make free space one byte below the acceptance estimate plus 1 GiB; separately make committed+staging+reserved bytes exceed 50 GiB by one byte.
expected: Inclusive valid limits are accepted when other requirements are met; over-limit input rejects with the stated code and with zero accepted mutation; reservation prevents quota overcommit; a post-accept ENOSPC ends the job failed with DISK_FULL (or interrupted when SQLite cannot commit) and prior artifact bytes are unchanged.

Free-space shortfall returns 503 DISK_FULL reason INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE retryable true; quota overrun returns 409 REGISTRY_LIMIT reason ROOT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED; neither creates a job, event or reservation.

cases.name: Use one error vocabulary and validation order
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: Submit inputs that fail two ordered validation stages; repeat an accepted request idempotently, then change its bytes.
Expire the session during an uncertain job submit, then reconcile before any retry.
For every contracts/error-vocabulary.json row with a synchronous kind, submit its fixture trigger; for every job kind, observe it on a failing job where the case matrix provides a trigger.
expected: The first stage's code and lexical field-error order are exact; one accepted job; conflicts or lost responses cannot duplicate or invent execution.
Every returned Error.code, reason_code, HTTP status and JobError.code equals its vocabulary row; no code outside the vocabulary is emitted.

cases.name: Keep progress, assessment, and test exposure independent
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: Toggle each progress dimension separately and export/import state.
Inspect self/independent/imported labels; in local mode consume a capstone token, then create an allowed replacement.
expected: No implied progress or verification; static never grants local attestation; a local replacement retains the prior consumption and shows reused test.

cases.name: Preserve complete import and reuse meaning
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: Export full and thin, inference-only and resume selections; import into a clean root with skip and with copy.
Test duplicate dependency resolution, a missing base, tampering and an omitted optimizer.
Submit tiny_resume and adapter_resume naming an inference_only checkpoint.

Import a thin adapter bundle into a clean root, then prepare the base and chat with it; import the same checkpoint twice, first inference-only then resume, with skip; import a bundle containing a conversation and a tokenizer; validate a bundle whose adapter_config.json contains C:\\Users\\a\\model.
expected: All IDs map and provenance is retained; full works with the network off; thin without base is base_required; resume only when complete; an invalid import is atomic.
Both return 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with reason_code CHECKPOINT_NOT_RESUMABLE and field_path /checkpoint_id before any job row or event exists.

Thin import succeeds as base_required with base_model_id null and binds after model_prepare by manifest digest; the resume copy is retained as a second checkpoint (different content and portability) and never skipped; identity_map lists the conversation and tokenizer with created dispositions and non-null local IDs; the absolute path fails validate_bundle with job error SEMANTIC_INVALID (BUNDLE_NO_ABSOLUTE_PATHS).

cases.name: Ship concrete teaching inputs and verifier profiles
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: Regenerate fixtures from authored facts and compare all materialized SHA256s.
Join verifier profile IDs, curriculum oracles, schema formats and acceptance-case references.
expected: Every fixture byte and verifier dependency exists and matches; no placeholder, invented label or simulation-as-measurement.

applied-intents-v1 and capstone-support-v1 contain only distinct user messages, and no cross-split pair exceeds word-set Jaccard 0.5 after code-insensitive normalization (check_fixture_oracles distinctness oracle).

cases.name: Resolve amendments before qualification
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate and contract/fixture digests; isolated data root; required native profile/browser available.
steps: Introduce contract drift in an isolated spec fixture and run the builder checks.
Amend the fixture and registry under a new revision and a new candidate.
expected: Drift fails; the amendment updates all consumers; prior candidate passes stay historical and new rows are NOT_RUN.
